tb-209-3.question:
X and Y are two points on a fidget spinner (Fig c).

When the spinner rotates about point O, X and Y must have the same

(1) angular speed.

(2) linear speed.

(3) centripetal acceleration.

A (1) only

B (1) and (2) only

C (2) and (3) only

D (1), (2) and (3)
tb-209-3.reasoning:
They have the same angular speed ω.

∴ (1) is correct.

By v = rω, the linear speed v increases with the radius r.

∴ (2) is incorrect.

By a = rω2, the centripetal acceleration a increases with the radius r.

∴ (3) is incorrect.

tb-209-4.question:
Music will be played when a record, which is a flat disc, is rotated by a player (Fig d). Suppose there is an ant on a record which rotates at a constant angular speed. Which of the following will decrease when the ant walks towards the centre of the disc?

(1) The ant’s angular speed

(2) The ant’s linear speed

(3) The net force acting on the ant

A (1) only

B (2) only

C (1) and (3) only

D (2) and (3) only
tb-209-4.reasoning:
The angular speed ω is constant.

∴ (1) is incorrect.

By v = rω, the linear speed v decreases when the radius r decreases.

∴ (2) is correct.

By F = mrω2, the net force (centripetal force) F decreases when the radius r decreases.

∴ (3) is correct.

tb-209-5.question:
X, Y and Z are three athletes running steadily on two circular tracks in an anticlockwise direction (Fig e). The positions of X and Y are always aligned with the centre O of the circular tracks. Y and Z run at the same linear speed.

Which of the following statements are correct?

(1) X will overtake Z.

(2) Z has a larger acceleration than X.

(3) The accelerations of X and Y always point in the same direction.

A (1) and (2) only

B (1) and (3) only

C (2) and (3) only

D (1), (2) and (3)
tb-209-5.reasoning:
By v = rω, since vY = vZ and rY < rZ,

ωY > ωZ.

Since ωX = ωY > ωZ, X will overtake Z.

∴ (1) is correct.

By a = rω2, since ωX > ωZ and rX = rZ,

aX > aZ.

∴ (2) is incorrect.

The accelerations always point to O. Since the positions of X and Y are always aligned with O, their accelerations always point in the same direction.

∴ (3) is correct.

tb-209-7.question:
Two identical bodies, X and Y, are connected with strings to a point O on a smooth horizontal plane (Fig g). They revolve steadily at the same angular speed about O. The tension in the string connecting O and X is T1 while the tension in the string connecting X and Y is T2. The two strings have the same length. Find the ratio of T1 to T2.

A 1 : 2

B 2 : 3

C 1 : 1

D 3 : 2
tb-209-7.reasoning:
The horizontal forces acting on X and Y are as shown.

Let L be the length of string connecting O and X.

Apply F = mrω 2.

Consider X.

T1 − T2 = mLω 2 (1)

Consider Y.

T2 = m(2L)ω 2 (2)

Divide (1) by (2):

T1−T2T2 =mLω2m(2L)ω2

T1T2− 1 = 12

T1T2 =32

The ratio of T1 to T2 is 3 : 2.
